method: build J via F_jacobian at first bias; compute SVD spectra of {J, Sr*J, J*Su, Sr*J*Su} for candidate Sr (row) and Su (column) scaling; count singular values below 1e-10 (the rank-deficient floor).

baseline_J.note: 9 singular values at machine floor + 33 structurally near-degenerate from n-p-n singularity

Sr_B (block-level _block_row_scales, no.verdict: ineffective - block-level scaling too coarse for 30-order SRV/carrier imbalance

Su (column scaling 1/colmax).verdict: column scaling alone also collapses floor 42 -> 2

Sr_A+Su.verdict: floor 1 but huge condition spread from unbounded Su scaling - need bounded log-QF coords

Sr_B+Su.verdict: block-level Sr_B ineffective regardless of Su

finding: Dense row equilibration (_row_equilibrate, the dense row-max variant) cuts the rank-deficient singular-value floor from 42 to 2 on the stress Jacobian. This ATTACKS the kappa~1e45 at the coordinate level - the same physics that required the lstsq fallback becomes well-enough conditioned to solve directly. The block-level _block_row_scales (currently wired into the adjoint path adjoint_banded_solve_blocks) is INSUFFICIENT (stays at 42) - it cannot tame the 30-order-of-magnitude SRV/carrier imbalances; only dense row-max scaling does.
implication_for_banded_GE: If dense Sr+Su conditioning is good enough everywhere (not just at the singular stress device), the O(N^3) SVD native solve could be replaced by a faster jnp.linalg.solve (LU) on the well-conditioned scaled system - OR the existing LAPACK path loses its lstsq-fallback knife-edge. This means SrJSu reformulation is HIGHER PRIORITY than the 4-8 week banded-GE rewrite: it attacks the conditioning, not the algorithm. The banded-GE may then be unnecessary entirely (or can use the cheaper un-pivoted banded path on the well-conditioned scaled matrix).
next_step_concrete: Wire the effective dense _row_equilibrate into BOTH the forward banded_solve and the transpose/adoint path (replace the ineffective _block_row_scales in adjoint_banded_solve_blocks), gated behind an env flag (DRIFTJAX_ROW_EQUIL=1) to bit-protect goldens; re-run the stress + working-device suites; confirm the singular stress Jacobian's floor drops to 1-2 and the working p-i-n is unaffected. Estimated 2-3 days; blocks nothing.
